notes.subject: to the hoping community
notes.rationale: Plural imperatives 'Aw kɔlɔsi' summon all who wait for Yawe

notes.subject: miiri caya
notes.rationale: ויאמץ is 'be stout/alert'; rendered as 'make the heart take breadth/courage' after the idiom

notes.subject: he shall strengthen vs let it take courage
notes.rationale: KJV reads ויאמץ as jussive of the speaker; ASV/JPS as third-person 'he will strengthen' — Bambara follows the jussive 'let your heart take courage'

translation: Aw kɔlɔsi, aw ka dusukunw miiri caya, aw bɛɛ minnu bɛ Yawe ma lasɔmi.
